LanguageData.RHA_Tactic_Invalid: Invalid tactical configuration; this attempt will end safely.
LanguageData.RHA_Tactic_Phase: Tactical phase {0} · tier {1} · next change in {2}s
LanguageData.RHA_Tactic_Contribution: Enemy {0}: applicant actual damage {1} · phase damage {2}/{3}
LanguageData.RHA_Tactic_Brief_thunder: Threat: a feeder protects linked enemies. Answer: focus, kill or control the feeder. Reward: linked enemies take 25% more damage for 8 seconds. Ordinary attacks always progress.
LanguageData.RHA_Tactic_Brief_flame: Threat: radius-2 embers last 6 seconds and deal 25% of base special damage per second; overlaps do not stack. Answer: bait a later locked attack into old embers or control its caster. Reward: consume the ember, cancel the attack and expose the caster for 8 seconds.
LanguageData.RHA_Tactic_Brief_blood: Threat: actual damage reaching 20% of maximum torso health starts an 8-second frenzy, once per phase. Answer: burst, trade hits or control it; stage five staggers frenzies. Reward: 25% more damage taken during frenzy.
LanguageData.RHA_Tactic_Brief_titan: Threat: nearby stationary enemies form up to 20% formation defense. Answer: pull them apart, control the anchor or concentrate actual damage. Reward: 25% more damage taken for 8 seconds after collapse.
LanguageData.RHA_Tactic_Brief_frost: Threat: frozen enemies defend and move slower. Answer: keep attacking or save burst for thaw; stage five staggers phases. Reward: thawed enemies take 25% more damage. Phases last at least 30 seconds.
LanguageData.RHA_Tactic_Brief_blade: Threat: a marked facing defends the front. Answer: hit the side or rear, or control it. Reward: 25% more damage taken for 8 seconds after stance break; no rebuild in that phase.
LanguageData.RHA_Tactic_Brief_marksman: Threat: a suppressor protects the shooter. Answer: focus or control the suppressor, or use cover. Reward: cancel the shooter charge and expose it for 8 seconds with 25% more damage taken.
LanguageData.RHA_Tactic_Brief_spirit: Threat: a supporter protects the primary through a pact. Answer: focus or control the supporter. Reward: 25% more damage taken by the primary for 8 seconds. Pacts move among survivors only; no resurrection.
LanguageData.RHA_Tactic_Brief_guardian: Threat: pursuit of the protected target. Answer: applicant actual damage to the threat, effective healing or real shield absorption. Reward: the shared phase threshold opens an 8-second counter window. Solo applicants protect themselves; the originally protected person must survive.
